{{Quote|By the style of their camp, I would say they are Yiwa of the Qiemo Adrangar. Not an unimportant clan, such as the Eijin or Gaxun, but not an overclan like the Borokii or the Januul, either.|Kyakhta|<ref name="AS">''[[The Approaching Storm]]''</ref>}}
The '''Qiemo Adrangar''' tribal faction was a collection of lesser [[Alwari]] clans that included the [[Yiwa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ansion/Legends|Ansion]].<ref name="AS" />
